propositions: structured_run.py exceeded 795 LOC, leaving only 4-5 lines of headroom below the 800-LOC hard cap enforced by CI module-size gate, blocking future additions

Three distinct responsibilities were conflated in a single module: run mechanism, cache-effectiveness diagnostics, and failure interpretation, causing maintenance friction and making the module harder to evolve

Extracting cache diagnostics (~230 LOC) and failure interpretation (~180 LOC) into separate modules reduces structured_run.py to ~390-436 LOC and provides stable decomposition seams that prevent re-inflation
All moved symbols must remain importable from structured_run.py via re-export shims to avoid breaking external import paths in runner.py, usage_report.py, capabilities.py, and existing tests
New modules cache_diagnostics.py and run_failure.py contain pure/observability code with no back-edges to the orchestrator, ensuring one-way dependency direction
The refactoring is behavior-preserving with byte-identical moved code; all existing tests pass without modification and all lint/type/size gates remain green
